title: Assault Duel
description: Take cover, sprint across tactical combat arenas, and outshoot elite squads in fast-paced arcade firefights packed with power-up drops.
controls: Move with touch controls to dodge enemy fire and lock onto targets to clear each combat arena.

zh-CN.title: 突击对决
zh-CN.description: 快节奏战术射击突击对决：依托掩体闪转腾挪，精准点射与手雷齐发击败精英特工小队！
zh-CN.controls: 滑动走位躲避弹雨并瞄准反击，拾取补给道具消灭场上全部对手。
